spec.description: Equilateral triangle with all three outer side labels retained, internal perpendicular altitude and right-angle marker at its foot. No midpoint ticks or angle labels added. Source altitude unit cm corrected to m to match metre givens and teacher result.
spec.mathematics: Three sides 8 m; altitude x m.
spec.answerVisibility: No calculated half-base, angle or height is supplied.

answer.worked:
The triangle is equilateral, so each angle is $60^\circ$. The altitude forms a right triangle with hypotenuse $8\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\sin60^\circ&=\frac{x}{8}\\x&=8\sin60^\circ\\x&=8\times\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\x&=4\sqrt3\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
